versions.content: If write verification is enabled (compile switch FlsWriteVerifi- cationEnabled set to TRUE): After writing a flash block, the function Fls_Main- Function shall compare the contents of the reprogrammed memory area against the contents of the provided application buffer to check that the block has been completely reprogrammed. If this check fails, the function Fls_MainFunction shall set the FLS module's job result to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED and raise the runtime error FLS_E_VER- IFY_WRITE_FAILED .
